title:
Marketing Mentor on Instagram: "Makro proved that waste is often just a perception problem. Fruit wasn't spoiling faster, people were just judging it sooner. 

One colour-coded sticker shifted that judgment and saved 70 tons a week. What else are we throwing away simply because it doesn't look the part?

#MarketingMentor"
